Package dev.px.core.notification

Class NotificationService

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.setting.SettingHolder
dev.px.core.notification.NotificationService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Named, Service
public final class NotificationService extends SettingHolder implements Service
The on-screen notification queue.

Core owns the lifecycle; drawing belongs to whichever HUD element the client writes. That split is what lets a notification be raised from a background thread: post(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, dev.px.core.notification.NotificationType) only enqueues, and the queue is drained on the render thread in getActive().

Being a SettingHolder gives the user control over the cap and whether notifications appear at all, without a separate settings mechanism.

      public List<Notification> getActive()
